userDirection: Finish improving the StarBlox art-factory path, then upgrade and optimize the 15 active scheduled tasks.

artFactory.note: Exact model/revision provenance remains required; repository-code, data/reference, API/service and custom-node terms remain separate.

operation: Optimized prompts/titles on the same 15 active automation IDs. No substitute tasks created. Existing staggered hourly schedules preserved.
promptOptimization: Every worker recomputes live state from branch evidence instead of trusting hard-coded manifest counts or stale blocker snapshots.

Every actionable generation uses the v2 factory contract: optimizer -> 2-4 bounded variants -> exact provenance -> repo staging/readback -> real render -> independent exact-hash review -> 08 integration.
Perceptual metrics remain report-only and cannot approve or reject art automatically.
Accepted exact hashes are preserved; unchanged transport/generation/review failures are not repeated for activity.
01/02/05/14 remain disjoint independent catalog reviewers; 08 remains the only canonical writer; 15 remains allocation owner.
Blocked/idle workers redirect to non-conflicting art evidence/specification rather than status-only churn.

schedulePolicy.reason: Existing minute staggering already limits simultaneous branch writes; this optimization targeted mission quality and dynamic coordination rather than introducing schedule churn.

note: This file records task configuration and factory policy, not future execution or finished artwork. Live branch evidence always overrides stale snapshots.
